title: Reference-anchored geometry diagnostics with noise-matched calibration and native-allocation checks
description: Calibration and sensitivity analysis of reference-anchored graph geometry and native probability-allocation diagnostics. The archive contains the manuscript, seven vector figures, analysis code, synthetic calibration arrays, saved measurement tables, and 24 matched representation/reference arrays. It supports fixed-object sensitivity and permutation analyses and independent numerical checks. Complete historical expression caches, all inventoried latent files and the complete historical multi-library calibration driver are not supplied.
